title: Agentic mandate (JWT claims set)
description: Claims carried in an EdDSA-signed JWT (typ: mandate+jwt). Documentation only: the gateway reads the `required` claims and ignores the rest.

iss.description: Issuer URL. Must resolve in the trust registry.

cnf.description: Proof-of-possession key of the delegate (RFC 7800). The agent signs each request with this key.

agent_id.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of cnf.jwk, or any stable id

clearance.description: Highest data level this mandate may call (1 public, 2 basic PII, 3 sensitive PII, 4 special category). Checked by gateway/lib/interfaces.py against each server's level. Absent: no check on pupil-data, CLEARANCE_MISSING on interface servers. The 'audit' server is level 2.

server.description: MCP server name as exposed by the gateway

constraints.description: Argument constraints: each key must appear in tool arguments with a value in the given list

rate.description: Per scope entry: per_minute (429 RATE_LIMITED) and max_calls (429 BUDGET_EXHAUSTED).

audience.description: Whose data this entry covers: 1 to 500 pupil IDs, fixed at signing. pupil_id and pupil_ids outside it are refused (AUDIENCE_VIOLATED); search and roster results are filtered at the tool through the tool grant. Any other form is AUDIENCE_INVALID.

max_rows.description: Most rows a tool may return under this entry; carried in the tool grant and enforced by the server. Default 100.

scope.description: Grants, one per entry. An audit-reader mandate uses server 'audit' (answered by the gateway itself, data level 2, so it needs clearance >= 2): {"server": "audit", "tools": ["events", "saw"], "constraints": {"principal": ["officer:jsmith"]}} or constraints {"jti": [...]}. See docs/audit-trail.md.

deny.description: Glob patterns over 'server.tool'; deny always wins over scope

counts.description: Safe counts for pupil-data.aggregate (docs/safe-counts.md). The gateway always refuses identifier columns, level-4 columns without clearance 4, more than 2 group_by columns and where on level 3-4 columns; it counts distinct pupils, drops groups smaller than k, hides counts and complements of 1-4, and rounds to 5. This claim can only make it stricter.

k.description: Minimum pupils per released group; values below the default 10 are ignored.

budget.description: Run budget across the mandate's life and its supplementary mandates (docs/run-budgets.md). Over it: 429 BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. Issuers copy it into supplementary mandates.

parent.description: Supplementary mandates only (add-scope-requests): the mandate this one was minted from. The gateway refuses this mandate with PARENT_REVOKED once the parent's status bit is set, and STATUS_UNAVAILABLE if it can't read the parent's list. Budgets count per family (parent.jti).

mandate_hash.description: sha256 of the parent's compact JWT; binds preapproved action hashes to the call that was held

approved_by.description: Supplementary mandates only: who approved the scope request it came from.

preapproved.description: Action hashes (sha256 of server, tool, exact arguments and the parent mandate hash) of held calls a person approved. Each is released once (reason PREAPPROVED); the mandate lives at most 5 minutes.

can_delegate.description: This mandate may approve another agent's scope request (grants.decide) from the same principal, but only for grants its own scope and clearance cover, and never a held call.

$comment: Tool grants (add-scope-requests): for every forwarded call the gateway signs a tool-grant+jwt with tool_grant_key.pem: aud = server, tool, args_hash, jti = the call's audit decision_id, sub = mandate jti, level, subjects {urns, pupils}, constraints, max_rows, exp (30 s). Servers verify it with tool_grant.pub and apply it to their output.
